**Finding: deviation (medium severity) — § 2.1**

§ 2.1 imposes exactly our walk-away position: a three-year, USD 2,000,000 per year take-or-pay commitment on Customer "without reduction or termination rights." It is also internally inconsistent with:
- **§ 12.3**, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made "no ... minimum-volume ... commitment"; and
- **§ 7.1**, which fixes Fees to those stated in Order Forms and bars Vendor from imposing "minimum-use" charges.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** replaced § 2.1 with a no-minimum formulation tying fees to Services ordered or actually used under § 7.1. The comment offers the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up rather than penalty) if a commitment is commercially essential to Vendor.
